keyword: what is the 25th amendment of the us constitution
claims: The 25th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution was ratified in 1967.
Section 1 of the 25th Amendment explicitly states that if the President is removed, dies, or resigns, the Vice President becomes President.
Section 2 of the 25th Amendment allows the President to nominate a new Vice President if the Vice Presidential seat is vacant, subject to a majority vote in both Houses of Congress.

Section 3 of the 25th Amendment enables the President to declare in writing they are unable to perform their duties, making the Vice President the Acting President until a written declaration to the contrary is submitted.
Section 4 of the 25th Amendment allows the Vice President and a majority of the Cabinet to declare the President disabled, immediately making the Vice President the Acting President.
If the President contests the declaration under Section 4 of the 25th Amendment, Congress determines the outcome.
The 25th Amendment was adopted following the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.
Section 3 of the 25th Amendment has been used multiple times.
Section 3 of the 25th Amendment has been used often during medical procedures.
Section 4 of the 25th Amendment has never been invoked
